title: DiagnosticsEnvelope
description: Machine-readable findings emitted by goobers validate and goobers lint.

safety.description: Additive warning-only workflow safety analysis; never affects execution.

version.description: Version of the workflow safety catalog and diagnostic detail contract.

id.description: Deterministic finding identity incorporating rule, scope, witness, workflow configuration, inherited gaggle controls, and binary identity.

workflow.description: Workflow whose compiled graph produced this advisory.

stage.description: Task, gate, or parallel stage associated with the advisory.

file.description: Workflow source file relative to the validated configuration tree, when available.

line.description: One-based YAML line of the associated stage, when available.

col.description: One-based YAML column of the associated stage, when available.

witnessPath.description: Ordered stage and outcome hops demonstrating the risk or the analysis boundary.

confidence.description: Strength of the static evidence; uncertainty and unknown behavior are not proofs of absence or safety.

coverage.description: Whether this finding concerns modeled behavior, partial knowledge, or an incomplete analysis path.

impact.description: Operator-facing consequence of the witnessed risk or coverage gap.

action.description: Suggested configuration repair or manual inspection; analysis never applies it automatically.

limitations.description: Qualifications separating static wiring and author assertions from verified live execution.

budget.description: Policy repass bound derived from the available run controls for a feedback or cycle finding.

budgetSource.description: Origin of the reported retry bound, including any unavailable instance-override qualification.

suppressedCode.description: Original safety rule code retained when a scoped suppression emits SAF007.

suppressionReason.description: Nonempty author-provided justification for the scoped suppression.
